text:
Assistant A provides code, but it is buggy. It passes the string '*.txt' to a function that iterates over it as if it were a list of files, so it would try to open each character as a filename. It also never uses glob or os.walk, so it does not actually read files under a directory. Even so, it is a partial attempt, and the counting logic with Counter and most_common(5) is correct.

Assistant B provides only an introductory sentence and no code, so it answers nothing.

A is better because it gives some usable content, even though it is flawed.

[[A]]
